extraction.Name: Rose Pourier Tibbits
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee but accepted it on the advise of the Farmer and Superintendent for they told her that if she did not take it and keep the taxes up that the land would be sold to pay them
extraction.Buyer: Alex Livermont for $35.00 per acre, which was a fair price for it
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes on her land so she had to sell it
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband who does common labor for a living
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in fair health; has no land and is living on the allotment of her son; has seven children; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since she was granted a patent; husband does not make much and they have a hard time; document sworn November 28, 1928; Shannon County, South Dakota
